answer: Reeds are stacked high against the barn wall, and the thatcher works the spars with practised hands. Proof of thatcher reed via spar hook tally — a roof the thatcher spars only after 11 roofs run true, each roof hooked by the thatcher himself. The marble shelters the cut reeds from the rain. The pigment marks the roofline where the new course begins. The whisper keeps the ladder steady against the eaves. Faking the tally means sparring 11 roofs, hooking 11 roofs and proving 11 roofs true, a fortnight on the roof for thatch that still leaks at the ridge.
